current_fact.en: C-2 CPU P0 fired a matched-simplification STOP on a 3x3 actor/evaluator cross-score matrix with frozen external anchors. The evaluator bias/shortcut parameters estimated by causal neutralization are exactly identical to simple intercept+shortcut calibration on the same anchor outputs, with identical repair MAE/max error. Keep the cross-version matrix only as a diagnostic; the standalone attribution + causal sparse-repair mechanism should not progress pending human merge/drop review.
